corrections.reason: The printed text clearly reads 'አምሳ ስልሳ ፋና' ('fifty or sixty torches'), where 1st-order 'አ' and 4th-order 'ሳ' were misread as 'እምስ'.

corrections.old_text: ና ዘዚአነ እሳት እንተ ኮነ ይት↵
corrections.corrected_text: ና ዘይእቲ እሳት እንተ ኮነ ይት↵
corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez liturgical citation ('ዘይእቲ እሳት እንተ ኮነ ይትዓፀፋ አዳም') and visual inspection of the printed glyph confirm 'ዘይእቲ' rather than 'ዘዚአነ'.
In the canonical Ge'ez citation of John 14:2 ('ውስተ ቤተ አቡየ ብዙኅ ማኅደር ቦቱ') and in the printed image, 'ብዙኅ' is in the nominative 6th order (ሳድስ 'ኅ'), not 4th order 'ኃ'.
